title: API Endpoints
summary: This module defines and manages all HTTP API endpoints for interacting with the model serving and management system, routing requests to appropriate handlers for various model operations.

nodes.label: API Endpoints
nodes.title: API Endpoints
nodes.description: Manages all incoming API requests, routing them to appropriate handlers for model interaction and management.

nodes.label: Chat Handler
nodes.title: Chat Handler
nodes.description: Processes incoming chat requests, manages model loading and execution, and streams responses back to the client.

nodes.label: Generate Handler
nodes.title: Generate Handler
nodes.description: Handles text generation requests, including prompt processing, model execution, and streaming responses.

nodes.label: Embed Handler
nodes.title: Embed Handler
nodes.description: Generates embeddings for given text inputs using a specified model, handling input truncation and parallel processing.

nodes.label: Pull Handler
nodes.title: Pull Handler
nodes.description: Manages requests to pull models from a registry, handling model name normalization and streaming progress updates.

nodes.label: Push Handler
nodes.title: Push Handler
nodes.description: Processes requests to push models to a registry, including model name resolution and streaming progress updates.

nodes.label: Show Handler
nodes.title: Show Handler
nodes.description: Retrieves and displays detailed information about a specified model, including its configuration and metadata.

nodes.label: Model Scheduling
nodes.title: Model Scheduling and Caching
nodes.description: Manages the loading, unloading, and scheduling of models for inference, optimizing resource utilization and response times.

nodes.label: Model Creation
nodes.title: Model Creation and Conversion
nodes.description: Handles the creation of new models from various source files and manages quantization and template application.

nodes.label: Model Metadata
nodes.title: Model Metadata and Prompting
nodes.description: Manages model-related metadata, including templates, system prompts, and capabilities, and handles prompt rendering.

nodes.label: External Registry API
nodes.title: External Model Registry API
nodes.description: Interacts with external model registries for pulling and pushing models, facilitating model distribution and versioning.

nodes.label: Cloud Proxy
nodes.title: Cloud Proxy
nodes.description: Routes requests for cloud-based models to the appropriate remote inference service, handling authentication and model name normalization.

nodes.label: Model List Cache
nodes.title: Model List Cache
nodes.description: Caches the list of available models and their metadata to improve performance for API requests.

groups.label: Request Handling
groups.title: API Request Handling
groups.description: Components responsible for receiving, parsing, and routing incoming HTTP requests to the appropriate internal handlers.

groups.label: Model Interaction
groups.title: Model Interaction Handlers
groups.description: Handlers that process requests directly related to interacting with models, such as chat, generation, and embedding.

groups.label: Model Management
groups.title: Model Management Handlers
groups.description: Handlers for managing the lifecycle of models, including pulling, pushing, showing details, and creation.

groups.label: Core Model Services
groups.title: Core Model Services
groups.description: Underlying services that manage model scheduling, metadata, and caching, supporting all model interaction and management.

groups.label: External Integrations
groups.title: External System Integrations
groups.description: Components that interface with external systems like model registries and cloud inference services.
